settings.title: Call recording
settings.intro: Recording is off until you turn it on. When it is on, a teammate reads the notice, the person answers, and only then does the recorder start. Recordings are deleted after the retention period.
settings.loadFailed: The recording rules could not be loaded.
settings.viewOnly: You can see these rules, but only an owner or admin can change them.
settings.enabledOn: On: teammates can record a call after the person agrees.

modeHint.confirmed: The person says yes to being recorded and the teammate saves the answer. The safest choice.
modeHint.announcement: The teammate reads the notice and the call goes on. Use this only where your legal advisor confirms an announcement is enough.

settings.retentionHint: Between {min} and {max} days. Older recordings are deleted every night; the call itself stays in the log.
settings.retentionInvalid: Enter a whole number of days within the allowed range.
settings.noticeHint: The teammate reads this out before recording. Up to {max} characters. Each change is saved as a new version.
settings.noticeRequired: Write the notice (at least {min} characters) to turn recording on.
settings.noticeSuggestion: This call may be recorded for quality and training. Do you agree to the recording?

consent.title: Ask before recording
consent.askConfirmed: Read the notice. Press the first button only if the person says yes.
consent.askAnnouncement: Read the notice, then start recording.
consent.declinedNote: Not recording: the person did not agree.
consent.off: Call recording is switched off for this workspace.
consent.failed: The answer could not be saved, so nothing is recorded: {message}

lifecycle.title: Recording and consent
lifecycle.deleteMessage: The audio file is removed for good. The call stays in the log.

errors.CALL_RECORDING_DISABLED: Call recording is switched off for this workspace.
errors.CALL_RECORDING_CONSENT_REQUIRED: This call cannot be recorded: the person has not agreed.
errors.CALL_RECORDING_CONSENT_INVALID: That answer cannot be saved for this call.
errors.CALL_RECORDING_ON_HOLD: This recording is on legal hold. Lift the hold first.
errors.CALL_RECORDING_SETTINGS_INVALID: The recording rules are not valid: write the notice first.
